title: Different Time, Different Language: Revisiting the Bias Against Non-Native Speakers in GPT Detectors

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the False Positive Rates (FPR) of three different types of LLM-generated text detectors (Naïve Bayes, RoBERTa-like, and commercial closed-source) on essays written by native versus non-native speakers of Czech, and comparing the text entropy/perplexity between the two groups.
